The '''Northern Continent''' was one of the three major land masses on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the [[Northern Ocean]], [[Triad Sea]], and [[Central Ocean]]. [[DarkStryder's Fortress]] was located on the Northern Continent.

The Northern Continent was the most habitable region on the planet, and the majority of the continent was covered in the ruins of a massive city that was originally inhabited by the [[Kathol (species)|Kathol]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Patches of the continent were [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] by the [[Charr Ontee]].
